note: match → physical venue (AWAY DAYS spec §20, 24.9.2026). One row per official international match in the match master. `venueId` names a row of venue-registry.json; `countryCode` is the physical country (it decides Away Days — never HOME/AWAY). `check` is what the venue source itself says about the match (date, Hapoel's side, Hapoel's goals first); the builder compares it with the match master and a disagreement is a CONFLICT, not a correction. A row with no venueId says why (`status`, `reason`) and what was considered (`candidates`) — the research queue reads it.
